newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs -Friday estimated 110,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs -Friday estimated 110,000 - USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog marketings Friday were 110,000 head, compared with 97,000 last week and 81,000 last year. Saturday's estimate was 15,000 head, compared with 13,000 last week and 29,000 last year.
Estimates include generally about 60 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts were $1.00 per cwt lower than mid-session Thursday. Trade moderately active for light demand and moderate offerings.
Sows: generally steady to 2.00 lower. US 1-3 300-450 lbs. 42.00 -43.00 42.50 -44.00

Compared to last week: Barrows and Gilts 1.50 higher. Sows generally steady to 2.00 lower. Receipts this week 533,000 last week 549,000, last year 542,000. Barrows and Gilts average weight for week ending Dec. 14, 1996 254.5 lbs compared to 255.1 lbs previous week 251.2 lbs last year.
